verdict.rationale: PagerDuty is an incident-management SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, and it does publish one. Its official local MCP server on GitHub gives MCP clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code tools to fetch and manage account data. The server supports API-token and OAuth authentication and comes with a sample VS Code configuration. A probe also confirms the dedicated developer docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of real-world agent use, and detailed evidence of the specific tools exposed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: PagerDuty's official local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server which provides tools to interact with your PagerDuty account directly from your MCP-enabled client.
enables AI assistants (like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or VS Code) to interact securely with your PagerDuty account
This supports the same authentication methods as the REST API, including API tokens and OAuth
PagerDuty's MCP server allows you to fetch and manage information in your PagerDuty account.
